summary: Transform your farming practices with our organic farming and sustainability training. Learn to protect the environment while boosting your yields.
lede: Organic farming training helps farm managers, advisers, and sustainability staff assess farm systems and plan practical improvements. Learners develop soil-health baselines and fertility plans using compost, nutrient cycling, cover crops, and rotations; apply ecological pest, water, and biodiversity management; and maintain field records and sustainability reports. The course supports decisions that balance productive farming with environmental stewardship under variable soil, labour, and budget constraints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, advise, measure, or document organic and sustainability performance in farming systems.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with farm operations, crop production, livestock systems, or agricultural extension. Prior exposure to soil management, basic agronomy, or sustainability reporting is helpful, but no coding or advanced technical software skills are required. A calculator, notebook, and access to sample farm records or field observations will support the exercises. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational level, with emphasis on applying frameworks, reading field data, and drafting practical plans rather than engineering new technologies.
